nodes.label: Rationale: Automating Manual Vercel Deploy
nodes.rationale: Automates what had been a manual `vercel --prod` deploy — a push to production touching dashboard/** now deploys itself rather than relying on someone remembering to run the CLI. VERCEL_ORG_ID/VERCEL_PROJECT_ID are not secret (plain project identifiers already visible in dashboard/.vercel/project.json, gitignored per-machine) but are passed as repo secrets anyway so the workflow avoids hardcoding them.
